'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]
****At least ten [[Shell (projectile)|shells]] hit the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] with both [[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] blaming each other for the attack, which damaged an office building and the plant's [[fire station]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62505815 (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Three [[Indian Army|soldiers]] are killed in an attack at a [[military base]] in [[Rajouri]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. Two of the attackers are killed in the ensuing [[shootout]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/militants-attack-indian-army-post-kashmir-3-soldiers-2-attackers-die-shootout-2022-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**Cleric [[Rahimullah Haqqani]] is killed by a [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] at a [[seminary]] in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|IS-KP]] claims responsibility for the killing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/11/taliban-say-bombing-kills-prominent-afghan-cleric-in-kabul (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/top-taliban-cleric-killed-in-kabul-suicide-blast-by-islamic-state/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
*Five people are killed and 100 others injured as security forces clashes with protesters demanding presidential election be held in November in [[Somaliland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-five-people-killed-100-hurt-somaliland-protests-2022-08-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''

*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Marshall Islands]]
***The [[Marshall Islands]] confirms its first death from [[COVID-19]] in a person from [[Majuro]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/472678/pacific-news-in-brief-for-august-11 (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Latvia–Russia relations]]
**The [[Saeima|Latvian Parliament]] declares Russia a [[state sponsor of terrorism]] over its [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/latvian-parliament-declares-russia-state-sponsor-of-terror-/6697478.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Estonia]] and [[Latvia]] formally withdraw from the [[Cooperation between China and Central and Eastern European Countries]] group amid tensions with [[China]] over its [[human rights in China|human rights record]] and its support of Russia's war on Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/latvia-estonia-withdraw-china-cooperation-group-2022-08-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Sierra Leone]] declares a nationwide curfew amid anti-[[government of Sierra Leone|government]] protests that have killed two [[Sierra Leone Police|policemen]] and one civilian. The [[West Africa]]n country is currently experiencing record [[inflation]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sierra-leone-imposes-nationwide-curfew-amid-deadly-anti-government-protests-2022-08-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Cincinnati FBI field office attack]]
**A gunman wearing [[body armor]] attempts to storm the offices of the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] in [[Cincinnati, Ohio]], United States. Following a subsequent police pursuit, he is killed in a standoff with police. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/08/11/us/fbi-cincinnati-shooting-news (''The New York Times'')]
*A man takes several employees hostage at a bank in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], demanding his bank savings and threatening to set himself on fire. Police officers, [[Lebanese Army|soldiers]], and intelligence agents surround the building. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/aug/11/gunman-takes-hostages-at-beirut-bank-to-try-to-free-his-trapped-savings (''The Guardian'')]
*At least eight people are killed in police raids in [[Curitiba]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2022/08/11/al-menos-8-muertos-en-operaciones-policiales-en-ciudad-brasilena-de-curitiba/ (Infobae)]
